_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Asɩm ɛyaa kɛ dealer

📖 GAME OVERVIEW:
• Iɛyaa kɛ pɩɣa {start_chips} chips
• Kɔɔrɩ kɛ 52 cards (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Iɛyaa kɛ dealer (house)
• Kɩlaʋ kɛ Ultimate Texas Hold'em structure: iɛyaa kɛ ANTE nɛ BLIND bets, pɩɣa 2 hole cards, kɛʋ kɩlaʋ PLAY bets pɩɣa betting phases, kɔɔrɩ community cards nɛ kɛʋ iɛyaa kɛ best 5-card hand kɛ dealer’s. Iɛyaa kɛ goal kɛ maximize iɛyaa winnings (kɛ iɛyaa kɛ better hand), kɛ minimizing iɛyaa losses (kɛ iɛyaa kɛ worse hand).
• Game kɛ ends kɛ iɛyaa kɛ 0 chips kɛ below kɛ start kɛ round (LOSS) kɛ complete 1000 rounds kɛ chips (WIN)

💰 BETTING STRUCTURE:
• ANTE: Mandatory ${ante} bet kɛ every round
• BLIND: Mandatory ${ante} bet kɛ every round
• PLAY: Optional bet kɛ gameplay. Throughout kɛ round, iɛyaa kɛ choose ONLY ONE kɛ following: (${ante4} kɛ done kɛ PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} kɛ done kɛ FLOP, kɛ ${ante} kɛ done kɛ RIVER. Can kɛ fold kɛ river, giving kɛ hand, nɛ making kɛ bet.)

🎴 CARD DEALING:
• Iɛyaa kɛ pɩɣa 2 face-up cards (iɛyaa hole cards)
• Dealer kɛ pɩɣa 2 face-down cards (hidden kɛ iɛyaa)
• 5 community cards kɛ dealt face-down initially
• Community cards kɛ revealed progressively kɛ game phases

🏆 DEALER QUALIFICATION:
• Dealer kɛ must kɛ at least kɛ PAIR (2 cards kɛ same rank) kɛ qualify, using kɛ 2 cards kɛ dealer’s hand nɛ kɛ 5 community cards.
• Dealer qualification kɛ affects kɛ betting outcomes, kɛ will kɛ explained later.

🎮 GAME PHASES & ACTIONS:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Actions: [4x] (${ante4}) kɛ [check]
  • [4x]: Place ${ante4} PLAY bet, kɔɔrɩ first 3 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, kɔɔrɩ first 3 community cards

📋 FLOP:
  • If 4x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-reveals last 2 community cards)
  • If no 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) kɛ [check]
  • [2x]: Place ${ante2} PLAY bet, kɔɔrɩ last 2 community cards
  • [check]: No additional bet, kɔɔrɩ last 2 community cards

📋 RIVER:
  • If 4x kɛ 2x bet placed: Only [skip] available (auto-proceeds kɛ showdown)
  • If no prior PLAY bet: [1x] (${ante}) kɛ [fold]
  • [1x]: Place ${ante} PLAY bet, kɛ proceeds kɛ showdown
  • [fold]: Give kɛ hand, lose ANTE nɛ BLIND bets

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • All cards kɛ revealed nɛ evaluated
  • Best 5-card hand kɛ 7 cards (2 hole + 5 community)
  • Bets kɛ settled according kɛ payout rules

💎 BET PAYOUTS:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer doesn't qualify: PUSH (bet returned)
  • Dealer qualifies & iɛyaa win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Dealer qualifies & iɛyaa lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Unaffected kɛ dealer qualification
  • Iɛyaa win: Bet returned nɛ additional payout kɛ iɛyaa hand strength
  • Iɛyaa lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

📊 BLIND BET PAY TABLE:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four kɛ a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Less kɛ Straight: No additional payout

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Unaffected kɛ dealer qualification
  • Direct comparison: Iɛyaa best hand vs Dealer's best hand
  • Iɛyaa win: 1:1 payout (bet + winnings)
  • Iɛyaa lose: Bet lost
  • Tie: PUSH (bet returned)

🎯 POKER HAND RANKINGS (Best kɛ Worst):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 kɛ same suit
  2. Straight Flush: 5 consecutive cards kɛ same suit
  3. Four kɛ a Kind: 4 cards kɛ same rank
  4. Full House: 3 kɛ a kind + 2 kɛ a kind
  5. Flush: 5 cards kɛ same suit
  6. Straight: 5 consecutive cards
  7. Three kɛ a Kind: 3 cards kɛ same rank
  8. Two Pair: 2 pairs kɛ different ranks
  9. One Pair: 2 cards kɛ same rank
  10. High Card: Highest card wins

⌨️  ACTION COMMANDS:
• [4x] kɛ [play bet 4x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY bet
• [2x] kɛ [play bet 2x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY bet
• [1x] kɛ [play bet 1x]: Place ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY bet
• [check] kɛ [c]: Check (no additional bet)
• [fold] kɛ [f]: Fold (give kɛ hand)
• [skip] kɛ [s]: Skip kɛ next phase (kɛ no action needed)

💡 STRATEGY TIPS:
• Strong starting hands (pairs, high cards) often justify 4x bets
• Consider dealer qualification - weak hands may push kɛ dealer doesn't qualify
• BLIND bet can kɛ very profitable kɛ strong hands (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Watch iɛyaa chip stack! If it goes kɛ 0 kɛ below kɛ start kɛ round, iɛyaa lose.

⚠️  IMPORTANT NOTES:
• ANTE nɛ BLIND bets kɛ mandatory kɛ every round
• PLAY bets kɛ optional nɛ strategic
• Make sure iɛyaa input kɛ correct action, nɛ only one action kɛ time.
